Among broken ribs of a sunken galleon, coral-encrusted captain's cabin glowing faintly, treasure spilling around her tail, a hanging lantern still casting amber light underwater.
In a luminescent sea-cave, bioluminescent ceiling pulsing pale cyan, a still glowing pool reflecting stalactites dripping silver light, she rests at the pool's mossy edge.
At a river-mouth where jade freshwater meets sea-blue, water-lilies floating around her, moss-covered rock beneath her tail, the two glowing currents swirling together softly.
Under an arctic ice-shelf, pale-blue sun-shafts piercing thin ice above, frost-pale tail glowing in cold light, seal-companions circling her in slow luminous rings.
In a turquoise tropical lagoon, palm-shadows rippling the glowing surface, coral garden blooming below her tail, a manta-ray gliding past in deeper jewel-blue water.
On a calm midnight sea, water flat as silver mirror, stars reflected perfectly around her, she rises waist-up with hair dripping threads of silver moonlight.
Clinging to a sea-stack in a hurricane, spray erupting white around her, hair and tail-fins whipping horizontal, sky bruised violet with lightning fracturing the clouds above.
In an enchanted jewel-lagoon, water gleaming from within in impossible blue, sea-flowers blooming coral-pink and gold below the surface, soft radiance rising through the shallows.
On a moonlit tide-pool grotto at the sea-cliff base, the pool glowing faint with bioluminescent algae, kelp-tendrils draped from the cave-mouth dripping silver above her.
In deep abyssal blue at the continental shelf's edge, a single sun-shaft from far above illuminating her alone, bottomless indigo void glowing faintly behind her tail.
On a pebbled cove at rose-amber dawn, sea-foam rolling slow around her rock, dewy light catching her scales in gold, gulls wheeling high in the blush sky.
In a sunken cathedral-wreck overgrown with soft coral, stained-glass portholes still casting colored light through water, she rests in the nave among drifting golden particles.
On a sea-cliff black-rock at violet sunset, gold sun-shafts spearing cloud-gaps above the glowing sea, her tail draping wet rock and dripping silver light into surf.
Inside a polar ice-cave, walls glowing translucent aquamarine, aurora-filtered light shifting green and violet above the ice, her tail curled on a ledge of glowing frost.
In a kelp-forest at dusk, amber light filtering through swaying canopy, she hides behind a curtain of kelp fronds, bioluminescent plankton drifting around her like slow embers.
On a shell-and-pearl encrusted mer-court balcony overlooking open glowing sea, sea-lanterns of living coral lighting the terrace, her tail draped over the luminous railing below.
In a freshwater lily-pond where the river widens before the sea, jade light filtering through lily-pads, soft gold shafts touching her scales, dragonflies hovering above her crown.
At the surface in a midnight storm's aftermath, clouds parting to pour moonlight onto still water, bioluminescent wake glowing blue-green where her tail stirs the calming sea.
In a tropical sea-cave with a glowing blue-water pool, sunlight refracting through a submerged arch casting rippling gold lattice across the cave ceiling above her raised face.
Underwater in an open mid-water column beside a passing humpback whale, sun-shafts from the surface catching both their forms in cathedral-gold light, plankton drifting between them.
In a luminescent grotto where sea-flowers bloom in impossible pink-gold along the walls, the water itself glowing faint violet, stalactites dripping soft light onto her upturned face.
